name: Gakkou Nanafushigi 3
source:
On sultry summer night five students gathered at school building to test their bravery. According to urban legend, one of the school wonders can be seen this night. After the horror story is told in the dark classroom, something begins to move...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
闷热的夏夜，五名学生聚集在教学楼里测试自己的勇敢。根据都市传说，今晚可以看到学校奇观之一。在黑暗的教室里讲完恐怖故事后，有东西开始移动……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
